candidates.rejection_reason: Strongest lead of the run and rejected on evidence, not on thesis. Three independent failures: (1) the 2026-10-15 ad-hoc release and the stated 2026-11-05 full-Q3 date are secondary_only - this environment's network policy blocks every issuer, regulator and market-data host, so no primary source could be opened; (2) eToro tradeability could not be verified because etoro.com is unreachable, and ETORO_TRADEABILITY.md rejects any name whose broker availability cannot be verified; (3) independently of both, no allowed setup produces a defensible planned R of at least 1.5. The post-earnings-drift reading is clean on repository price data - a +11.2% gap on 2026-10-16 from 34.86 to an open of 38.78, closing 39.14 above the open, with the session low 38.48 holding far above the gap midpoint of 36.82 on 1.38M shares against a roughly 600k 20-session average - but SETUPS.md requires entry above a consolidation high with the stop below the gap-day low, and only one post-gap session exists, so no consolidation has formed. Taking the gap-day high as the trigger (40.10) against the gap-day low as invalidation (38.20) and the 2026-09-23 swing high as a conservative first target (42.00) yields exactly 1.00R. Reaching 1.5R from that entry requires either a target of about 42.95 above the 20-day high, or a stop inside the gap-day range, which the red team treats as a manufactured level. Carry forward as the priority object for the next run.
